_comment: CPAN 2026 talk (English). Deep-merged over labels.json by scripts/m13/presentation/cpan_results_figures.py: keys here win, everything else is inherited. No middle dot in any figure text (use parentheses, a dash or a colon). Every colour drawn in F06-F12 and the contact sheet comes from 'colors' / 'cmap' below; the code has no colour literals.

_doc.colors.score_r: F07 points, F08 points: residual score r
_doc.colors.score_r_sigma: F07 points, F08 points: normalised score r/sigma
_doc.colors.validity_band: F07 band (|coverage - 0.90| <= 0.015), F08 band (max. conditional deviation <= 0.015)
_doc.colors.final_model: F06 points (sigma groups), F11 mu and 90 % interval
_doc.colors.pair_mc_mtot: F09a chirp mass and total mass correlation
_doc.colors.pair_mtot_chi: F09a total mass and chi_eff correlation
_doc.colors.ellipse: F09b, F12, F12_main conformal 2D ellipse (must differ from the two pair colours)
_doc.colors.box: F09b, F12, F12_main box of the two intervals
_doc.colors.median_line: F10 median prediction by bins of truth
_doc.colors.lvk_neutral: F11 / F12 legend patch for LVK samples (the drawn samples use colors.events)
_doc.colors.neutral: legend-only markers (F07 val / test, F08 not valid and bin sizes, F09a empirical / implied), F11 out-of-support tick label
_doc.colors.background: figure and axes background (all figures, contact sheet)
_doc.colors.error_text: contact sheet: list of figures not produced
_doc.colors.events.<GW>: F11 half violins, F12 / F12_main LVK samples and 90 % contour
_doc.real_events.main_events: F12_main: the three events in one row, in this order
_doc.contact_sheet_ids: figures shown in contact_sheet.png, in this order
_doc.style.single: per-variable figures (F06, F07, F08, F10, F11 _<label>) and F09a: size and font sizes; F09b and F12_main use style.fig_wide with these fonts
_doc.colors.network: everything that is our network (prediction, normalised selected method, conformal ellipse, F06m/F06mv2 group curve, F08sv2 selected star); v1 slide versions (F03v2, F06m, F07b, F08s, F09c, F10m, F11v2, F12v2) use it too when re-run
_doc.colors.mondrian_raw: F07b: Mondrian bins with raw score (geometry of the previous pipeline)
_doc.colors.region_*: F09c points: inside both / ellipse only / box only / outside
_doc.figure_options.F11v2.ylim: F11v2 y limits per variable, [low, high], null = automatic
_doc.style.slide: slide versions: size (in), font sizes (pt) and legend background alpha; style.slide_full is the F11v2 size
_doc.contact_sheet_ids (results): only the _chirp_mass slide versions and the single figures (latest version of each)
_doc.colors.true_fill: F10mv2 / F06mv2 marginals: filled histogram of the true values (|y - mu| in F06mv2), alpha = alpha.true_fill, no edge
_doc.colors.pred_line: F10mv2 / F06mv2 marginals: line histogram of the network prediction (predicted sigma in F06mv2)
_doc.colors.lvk_fill: F11v3 LVK violins (alpha = alpha.lvk_fill), F12v3 LVK samples (alpha = alpha.lvk_samples)
_doc.colors.lvk_line: F11v3 LVK median (solid) and 5 % / 95 % (dashed) across the violin width
_doc.colors.method_raw / method_mondrian / me: F07bv2 methods (one width for all / one width per bin / width prop. to sigma); F07q left (raw) and right (normalised) points. A value '@key' is an alias of colors.key
_doc.colors.config_r / config_r_sigma: F08sv2 points: score r / score r/sigma (pastel; aliases of method_raw / method_mondrian)
_doc.alpha.*: alpha of true_fill (F10mv2, F06mv2), lvk_fill (F11v3 violins), lvk_samples (F12v3 scatter)
_doc.figure_options.F11v3.ylim: F11v3 y limits per variable, [low, high], null = automatic
_doc.figure_options.<ID>.size: figure size in inches of F03v3, F03asd, F07q, F12v3
_doc.figure_options.marginal_frac: F10mv2 / F06mv2: height of the top marginal and width of the right marginal as a fraction of the main panel
_doc.style.legend_compact: v2/v3 figures (F03v3, F03asd, F06mv2, F07bv2, F07q, F08sv2, F09av2, F10mv2, F11v3, F12v3): legend inside the axes, placed where it overlaps the fewest drawn artists
_doc.style.slide.pad_inches: bbox tight padding of the v2/v3 figures
_doc.style.min_axes_pt: v2/v3 figures: minimum font size of axis labels and tick labels (checked before saving)
_doc.colors.grid_soft / style.grid_soft_lw: F10mv3, F06mv3, F13: soft grid at the major ticks (main panel and marginals), below the data
_doc.figure_options.hexbin_fine_factor: F10mv3 / F06mv3 hexbin gridsize = round(factor x the v2 gridsize: 55 / 50)
_doc.figure_options.F06mv3.abs_error_percenti: F06mv3: both axes from 0 to max(this percentile of |y - mu|, max sigma); rows outside counted in the manifest
_doc.figure_options.F11v4.ylim / F11h.xlim: F11v4 y limits per variable and F11h x limits (chirp mass), [low, high], null = automatic
_doc.F11v4 / F11h colours: LVK half violins in colors.events (as F11v2, alpha 0.65 with edge); median (thicker) and 5 / 95 % solid lines in colors.lvk_line; network in colors.network
_doc.F12v4 colours: LVK samples (alpha 0.25) and 90 % contour in colors.events (as F12v2); ellipse colors.network; mu colors.mu
_doc.figure_options.F12v4.legend_max_headroom: F12v4: if no legend location of the three panels has overlap 0, the y range grows by 10 % per step, at most this many steps
_doc.colors.f13_*: F13 points inside the box (grey), outside the box and inside the ellipse (teal), outside both (dark grey); box (black, dashed); bands of the two 90 % intervals (f13_band, alpha.f13_band)
_doc.figure_options.F13: F13 axis limit (+-lim on both axes, equal aspect) and size
_doc.figure_options.F06mv4: F06mv4: both axes from 0 to fixed_limit (if not null) or max(abs_error_percentile of |y - mu|, max sigma); rows outside counted in the manifest
_doc.colors.f13v2_ellipse_only: F13v2 points outside the box and inside the ellipse (blue)
_doc.figure_options.F06c: F06c: x from 0 and y symmetric, both to fixed_limit (if not null) or max(abs_error_percentile of |y - mu|, max sigma); rows outside counted
_doc.colors.f14_line: F14a, F14c, F14d, F15b, F15c: grey lines (strain, noise, data)
_doc.figure_options.F14 / F15: F14a-d and F15a-c sizes (each PNG the same size); F14d inset bounds (axes fraction)
F06cv2: +-sigma line colour, line widths and white outline extra width
_doc.colors.rms_sigma / alpha.f16_band / figu: F16 / F16b: RMS(sigma) dashed line, RMSE bootstrap band alpha, size
_doc.colors.train_curve / chosen_epoch / para: F17: train loss curve, chosen-checkpoint line, per-parameter val RMSE curves
_doc.figure_options.F14v2 / F15v2: F14v2a-d landscape size and F14v2d inset bounds (axes fraction); F15v2a/b size_ab, F15v2c size_c
_doc.colors.dropout_off_epoch / figure_option: F17v2: dotted mark at the dropout switch-off epoch; line_lw / marker_ms scale the M13_6 notebook style (lw 1.2, ms 3) to the slide
_doc.figure_options.F18: F18a/b: as F12v4 (size, legend headroom steps) in the chi_eff planes
_doc.figure_options.F17v3 / F18grid: F17v3 as F17v2; F18c/F18d 3 x 3 grid size and legend headroom steps
